fundamental_rights: Every Indian citizen aged 18+ has the right to vote (Article 326)
You cannot be turned away from voting due to caste, religion, sex, or race
You are entitled to a secret ballot — no one can compel you to reveal your vote
You can vote even if your name has a minor spelling error in the electoral roll
Differently-abled voters get priority access and assistance at polling booths
Voters in essential services can apply for postal ballot
You have the right to NOTA (None of the Above) if unsatisfied with all candidates
documents_accepted: Smart Card issued by RGI under NPR
Service identity cards with photo (Central/State Govt employees)
Official identity cards issued to MPs/MLAs/MLCs

voter_checklist.task: Check your name in the electoral roll at voterportal.eci.gov.in
Know your polling booth via the Voter Helpline App or SMS
Check the election date and phase for your constituency
Carry a valid photo ID on polling day
Arrive at your polling station 30 minutes early
Collect your voter slip from the Presiding Officer
Press the button next to your chosen candidate on the EVM
Verify your vote on the VVPAT slip (visible for 7 seconds)
Apply the indelible ink mark — proof you voted!

model_code_of_conduct_key_points: No new government schemes or projects can be announced after MCC kicks in
Political parties cannot use religion, caste or community to solicit votes
Government vehicles cannot be used for election campaigns
Candidates must submit election expenditure statements within 30 days of results
Polling booths must be within 2km of every voter
Polling day is a paid holiday for government employees
